name: bash
description: Run a shell command. On Windows, defaults to cmd.exe; PowerShell, Git Bash and WSL bash are tried automatically if available. You can force a specific shell via the optional 'shell' parameter ('cmd', 'powershell', 'bash', etc.). On non-Windows systems, /bin/bash is preferred. Honors optional 'cwd' and 'timeout_seconds' parameters.

shell.description: Optional. Override the shell. Accepts an alias such as 'cmd', 'powershell', 'pwsh', 'bash' or a full path. The first available shell is used; fallbacks are tried automatically if the requested one is missing.

cwd.description: Optional. Working directory for the command. Defaults to the current process working directory.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional. Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the command. Defaults to 120.
